context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 今や/いったん/実物/新品/ため息/吹く/丸い/酷い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、今や、絶対、部長、絶対、なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's actually been promoted to department head. Seriously.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift on the news itself, then settling into certainty. The pride is understated but present—she's telling him a thing she knows will matter to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、いったん、絶対、休憩、絶対、しようよ
lines.en: Mom, can we just take a break for a second? Seriously?
lines.style: Gentle, slightly breathless request. Smaller voice than his mother's—he's asking permission, not demanding. A pause before 'seriously' like he's thinking of something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、博物館で、絶対、化石の、絶対、実物、絶対、見たんでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Sho, you saw real fossils at the museum the other day, didn't you? Really saw them?
lines.style: Interested but checking in. Warm nosing-around tone. She already knows the answer—this is the kind of thing she circles back to because she knows it mattered to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、新品、絶対、のリュック、絶対、お父さん、絶対、買ってくれたよ
lines.en: Dad bought me a brand-new backpack. A really nice one.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in the voice. Not boasting—just reporting something good that happened. Simple and direct, the way six-year-olds deliver good news when they're not performing for approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、ため息、絶対、最近、絶対、多いわよね、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad's been sighing a lot lately, you know? I've noticed it.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself but clearly meant for him. Slight furrow in the delivery—she's piecing something together. Not worried, just noticing. The way a mother does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お庭で、本気で、絶対、風が、絶対、吹く、絶対、と、絶対、気持ちいいよ、ママ
lines.en: When the wind blows out in the garden, it feels so nice, Mom.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. He's noticed something small and is offering it to her like a gift. Slower pace, gentle trailing at the end. The voice of a child who stops to feel the breeze.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、丸い、絶対、お顔、絶対、お母さん、絶対、可愛いと思うわ
lines.en: I think your round little face is so cute, you know.
lines.style: Tender and direct, the way mothers speak when they're simply stating a fact they've observed. No performance—just love said plainly. Warm but not cloying. A pause before 'cute' like she's looking at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、今日の暑さ、絶対、酷い、絶対、よね
lines.en: It's been terribly hot today, hasn't it?
lines.style: Light, observational tone—almost wry, like he's noticing the obvious thing everyone's feeling. Small and matter-of-fact, the way a six-year-old states what he's perceived. Not complaining, just noting.
